# Audio fixtures

All signals are generated by `npm run fixtures` from the repository script; there is no third-party recorded audio. WAV files use 48 kHz, 0.1 seconds (except the explicit short/empty cases). Channel `c` contains a 0.5-amplitude sine at `300 + c × 300` Hz. `dual.wav` contains 1 kHz and 4 kHz tones, each at 0.25 amplitude. Silence, non-finite float, corrupt, truncated and seven-channel files test rejection/boundaries.

FLAC and MP3 are encoded from those WAV signals by the pinned, development-only ffmpeg-static package. FFmpeg is never a runtime dependency or distributed with the app. The adjacent SHA-256 manifest records original encoded bytes and independently decoded FFmpeg frame counts for valid MP3 fixtures. MP3 length is counted from decoded packets with explicit encoder delay/padding removed; bitrate-estimated duration never trims the output. CBR/Xing, VBR without Xing, and truncated versions of both are included.

`npm run fixtures -- --perf` writes ten-minute 48 kHz six-channel and stereo WAV files in ignored `.test-output/audio/`, streaming bounded blocks to disk.
